title: Bounded symmetric scalar Gaussian channels have an exact twelfth-order relative-Fisher expansion
scope: One fixed bounded symmetric centered unit-variance real seed under the scalar Gaussian channel, with probabilists' Hermite normalization.

gu_typed_objects.carrier: a fixed bounded symmetric real probability law X with E X=0 and E X^2=1
gu_typed_objects.map: X -> sqrt(t) X + sqrt(1-t) G, followed by the density ratio against the standard Gaussian
gu_typed_objects.quantifiers: for each fixed bounded symmetric seed as t tends to zero
gu_typed_objects.owner: repository-internal scalar-channel calculation; no source-owned state, action, observation or physical probability law

hermite_law.derivation: Expand integral phi (r_t')^2/r_t with the Mehler density ratio, invert r_t as a formal series, and evaluate every Gaussian Hermite contraction exactly.
hermite_law.normalization: H_n is the probabilists' Hermite polynomial and E[H_n(G)^2]=n! for G standard Gaussian.

scope_guard: The law is a fixed-seed local expansion. It is not uniform for moving laws, growing support, vanishing defect, singular chart boundaries or finite channel strength, and it supplies no source-owned Hamiltonian, state, observation, prediction or confirmation.
